## Teaching Update

- [ ] Student-facing reason for the change is stated.
- [ ] Method, parameters, units, and replay path are preserved.
- [ ] SIGIL API changes include old surface, new surface, student impact, and migration note.
- [ ] New or changed outputs are traceable.
- [ ] Accessibility and first-user readability were checked.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_course_kqc.py` passes.
